topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and context for the lecture on the complement system.

topics.label: Fundamentals of complement architecture and C3 activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the basic organisation, nomenclature rules, and pivotal central role of component C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the alternative, lectin, and classical recognition pathways initiate complement activity and reach the threshold for activation.

topics.label: Effector functions of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream mechanisms by which activated complement eliminates pathogens through opsonization, inflammatory signaling, and membrane attack lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the regulatory factors and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the medical presentations and disease risks associated with specific genetic or acquired complement pathway deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the molecular strategies evolved by pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus to counteract complement-mediated immune destruction.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the session and introduces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
